art_direction: 深色木雕器像半轮月包住内腔，年轮顺着弧面展开，底座简洁。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Carve an original crescent-shaped vessel from dark walnut, its open inner cavity facing the viewer at three-quarter angle. Let the outer curve remain thick and rounded while the rim narrows into a carefully finished edge. Show wood grain following the arc, with one small natural knot near the base. Use a simple low foot carved from the same block. Warm side lighting should reveal the tool-finished surface and the shadowed interior. Place it against a muted olive-gray background without flowers, furniture, or other objects. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
